proposal.measures: ratio of long-gap (H-1 step) to short-gap (1 step) residual increment power
proposal.rationale: the planted component sits at period 4*(H-1): it contributes ~2% of the 1-step-gap increment power but ~27% of the full (H-1)-step-gap power on channel 0, so only a long-horizon contrast reads it; e is the full realization of the same residual process r samples at the origins, so the witness estimates the horizon contrast on e at full sample size

rationale: Horizon-range: structure that is invisible at short forecast horizons and only detectable at long ones.  A stationary series injection cannot literally scale with h (h indexes read offsets of one fixed series), so the design is realized spectrally: a narrowband component at period 12 = 4*(H-1) added to channel 0 of a white clean process (phi=0 AR(1) plus white noise, no autocorrelation to hide it).  Its 1-step increments carry a 1-cos(2*pi/12) ~ 13% fraction of its amplitude squared against a clean gap-1 power of 2*Var, while its full 3-step increments carry 1-cos(pi/2) = 100% — a ~24% power ratio shift that a short-horizon probe cannot see (2% relative on gap 1).  The witness is the ratio of (H-1)-step to 1-step residual increment power on channel 0; the marginal std perturbation is ~13% (gate 3) and the band-24/lag-3/bilinear probes see nothing (gate 2).
